instruction: Use SOLIDWORKS 2025 through Windows command-line/API automation. The PNG engineering drawing supplied with this message is mandatory and is the primary public geometry evidence. Inspect every orthographic and isometric view, printed dimension, centreline, hidden line, and drawing note in the PNG drawing supplied with this message before modelling. Then read C:\Users\User\Desktop\supplement.csv only for datum, feature direction, depth, array phase, and connectivity facts intentionally omitted from the sheet; it does not replace the drawing geometry. Interpret the orthographic views using ISO first-angle projection. Reconstruct the mechanical part in millimetres as exactly one valid connected solid. Do not infer dimensions from the task title or evaluator, and do not import or use any ground-truth STEP. Launch SOLIDWORKS with C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe when needed. Use SOLIDWORKS API/COM automation from VBA, C#, PowerShell, or Python COM; mouse-driven GUI interaction is not required. Export only the final solid as C:\Users\User\Desktop\result.step using millimetres and the default model coordinate system. Clear all selections before STEP export so the complete body is exported. Do not create metrics.json or reference_dimensions.csv; they are evaluator artifacts.
